Name: Normal Sized Evelyn
Author: kisforkup
Description:
I've made Evelyn ever-so-slightly bigger so that she fits in with the rest of the characters, as she was a bit small and looked like a crinkled tissue. I don't use any programs such as SMAPI or Content Patcher, so if anyone wants to make a version compatible with those formats, feel free :)

[b]Mod Includes:[/b]
Evelyn's Portraits (PNG File)
Evelyn's Portraits (XNB File)

[b]XNB Instructions:[/b]
Locate your Characters' Portraits within the Stardew Valley files, and simply drag and drop the XNB file in. This is intended to replace the default Evelyn portrait, so make sure to have a backup of your game files in case you ever want to change back. You may delete the PNG if you don't plan to use it for anything.
